jobs.occupation: Production Engineer  Process, Product, Assignment or Lead
jobs.description:
At Multiply, you become part of a technology-driven company combining advanced customer projects, product development, and competence building.
Multiply is an end-to-end provider of products, services, and training within engineering, automation, embedded systems, functional safety, cybersecurity, electronics, and advanced product development. Through our VisFlow platform, we also support structured development, operational visibility, compliance, and lifecycle governance across complex industrial environments.

About the Role
We are continuously looking for Production Engineers, Industrialization Engineers, Process Engineers, Product Engineers, and Technical Leads who want to develop robust, efficient, and sustainable production environments.
Depending on your background and the assignment, you may work with daily production support, process development, industrialization, product introduction, technical project leadership, or strategic production improvements.
Your responsibilities may include:
Leading industrialization from prototype and pre-series phases to stable series production
Developing and optimizing production processes, production flows, layouts, and working methods
Supporting NPI, product introduction, production ramp-up, and manufacturing readiness
Improving daily production operations through troubleshooting and technical support
Applying Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and Value Stream Mapping
Performing capacity, resource, cycle-time, and production-flow analyses
Conducting root-cause analysis, risk assessments, and quality improvement activities
Planning and coordinating production equipment, technical installations, and process changes
Defining technical requirements for equipment, suppliers, and production solutions
Participating in technical reviews of equipment, processes, layouts, safety, quality, and ergonomics
Supporting automation, digitalization, Industry 4.0, and cost-reduction initiatives
Developing standardized production methods, documentation, instructions, and best practices
Collaborating with production, quality, maintenance, design, logistics, purchasing, and suppliers

For senior profiles, the role may also include leading industrialization projects, coordinating technical workstreams, managing stakeholders, mentoring colleagues, and driving both operational and strategic improvement initiatives.

Your Profile
We welcome experienced Production Engineers as well as senior specialists and technical leaders.
You likely have experience within one or more of the following areas:
Production engineering, manufacturing engineering, process engineering, or product engineering
Industrialization from prototype to series production
Production development, NPI, ramp-up, or manufacturing readiness
Layout planning, flow optimization, capacity planning, and resource planning
Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, VSM, or continuous improvement
Root-cause analysis, risk management, and quality-controlled production
Technical project management or cross-functional coordination
Production equipment, technical installations, tooling, or manufacturing processes
Technical documentation, work instructions, specifications, and standardized methods

Experience with the following is considered valuable:
CAD and production-layout tools
ERP, MRP, or SAP environments
MES and production management systems
Automation, robotics, and Industry 4.0
Supplier coordination and technical procurement
FAT, SAT, commissioning, and production ramp-up
Ergonomics, workplace design, and production safety

For senior assignments, approximately 8–15+ years of relevant experience may be required. Some specialist and lead roles may require at least 10 years of experience and documented responsibility for industrialization, production development, or technical project delivery.

You Are
Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented
Hands-on while able to maintain a strategic perspective
Comfortable managing several activities in parallel
Quality-focused and committed to robust production solutions
Communicative and effective in cross-functional environments
Motivated by improving products, processes, and production flow
Able to take ownership and drive activities from analysis to implementation

Education
Relevant educational backgrounds include:
Mechanical Engineering
Production or Manufacturing Engineering
Industrial Engineering
Electrical Engineering
Mechatronics
Automation Engineering
Process Engineering
Other related technical disciplines

Equivalent practical experience from advanced industrial production environments is also highly valuable.

Language and Security
Depending on the assignment, requirements may include:
Professional communication skills in Swedish and English
Swedish citizenship
Ability to successfully complete a security clearance

For certain international assignments, English may be sufficient.
Applications are reviewed continuously. 

We welcome both experienced engineers and senior specialists interested in future opportunities with Multiply

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager Performance Analytics - Nordics Cluster
jobs.description:

In this position you'll own performance analytics for Nordic market and help its Country Director grow the business. That covers every function: marketing, CRM, product and operations, and how together they drive revenue.
You'll work with the Country Director and their functional leaders every week. You'll run the monthly and quarterly business reviews and explain to the Executive Committee how the market has performed. You'll help shape the annual strategy, and you'll challenge the Country Director when the numbers point somewhere else. The Nordics is a priority for the Group, so your work will be seen. You' will be a part of the senior performance analytics team, and the role gives you plenty of room to grow.
YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:
Own the performance numbers for your market and explain what is driving results

Turn analysis into clear recommendations for the Country Director and functional leaders
Run the monthly and quarterly business reviews and present market performance to the Executive Committee
Help shape the market's annual strategy and feed driver-level inputs into the forecast
Take complex business questions from first framing to a clear recommendation
Own the market's KPIs and dashboards, working with central BI, data engineering and data science
Lead analytics projects with central data teams and guide other analysts in the team

OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Om tjänsten

Internationella Engelska Skolan Värmdö öppnade 2021 och har sedan dess byggt upp en stark skolkultur med tydliga rutiner, höga förväntningar och goda relationer mellan elever och personal. På IES Värmdö arbetar vi tillsammans för att skapa en trygg, lugn och positiv lärmiljö där elever ges bästa möjliga förutsättningar att utvecklas både kunskapsmässigt och socialt.

Skolan har idag cirka 610 elever i årskurs F–9 och omkring 65 medarbetare. Vi söker nu en engagerad och trygg elevassistent till lågstadiet som vill vara med och stötta en elev i skoldagen och bidra till en stabil och inkluderande lärmiljö.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som elevassistent arbetar du nära en elev under skoldagen och hjälper till att skapa förutsättningar för eleven att lyckas både socialt och kunskapsmässigt. Du stöttar eleven under lektioner, övergångar, raster och andra delar av skoldagen, och vid behov även under fritidsverksamheten.

Du blir en viktig vuxen i elevens vardag och samarbetar nära med lärare, fritidspersonal, elevhälsa och vårdnadshavare. Rollen kräver tålamod, flexibilitet och ett lugnt och tydligt bemötande. Du behöver kunna anpassa ditt stöd utifrån elevens behov samtidigt som du bidrar till struktur, trygghet och positiva relationer.

På IES Värmdö arbetar vi med gemensamma rutiner och ett nära samarbete mellan olika personalgrupper. Vi söker därför dig som tycker om att arbeta i team och som delar vår övertygelse om att tydlighet, relationer och höga förväntningar hjälper elever att lyckas.

Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning på 100 %.

Vi söker dig som:

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn eller ungdomar
- Har erfarenhet av eller intresse för att arbeta med elever med NPF eller andra behov av stöd
- Är lugn, ansvarstagande och lösningsfokuserad
- Har lätt för att skapa goda relationer med elever
- Är flexibel och kan anpassa ditt stöd utifrån situation och behov
- Tycker om att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika yrkesgrupper
- Har god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har:

- Erfarenhet av arbete i skola eller fritidshem
- Utbildning eller kurser inom exempelvis NPF, pedagogik, konflikthantering eller bemötande
- Erfarenhet av lågaffektivt bemötande eller arbete med extra anpassningar och särskilt stöd

Personliga egenskaper

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som är trygg, lyhörd och har ett genuint engagemang för att stötta barn i deras utveckling. Du är en stabil vuxen som kan skapa förtroende och bidra till ett lugnt och positivt klimat omkring eleven.

Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, men vi söker någon som är villig att lära sig, samarbeta och vara en aktiv del av skolans arbete kring elevens utveckling och välmående.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

ECAD Tool Owner / EPLAN Specialist for a Global Engineering Environment in Linköping
Description
We are looking for a consultant to take overall responsibility for EPLAN within an international, technology-focused organisation. The assignment combines an understanding of electrical design with application management, user support and the development of working practices. You do not need to know every aspect from day one, but you should understand EPLAN and be able to drive initiatives in collaboration with users, IT and other technical teams.
About the assignment
As ECAD Tool Owner, you will have global responsibility for managing and further developing the EPLAN environment. The role combines technical and coordination responsibilities: gathering business requirements, leading discussions with key users and ensuring that tools, guidelines and integrations evolve in a structured way.
A key part of the assignment is the integration between EPLAN and Teamcenter via XPLM. You will take the lead on project activities related to this integration, including planning user testing and introducing the solution to different user groups. An electrical designer already provides backup support for administration and ongoing project activities, creating a solid foundation for handover and collaboration.
Your responsibilities will include:
Acting as the global administrator and Tool Owner for EPLAN.
Leading and developing the organisation’s key user community.
Gathering requirements, improvement suggestions and user feedback.
Planning and implementing EPLAN updates.
Creating and maintaining guidelines and shared working practices.
Managing licences and related application management activities.
Taking responsibility for the EPLAN infrastructure in collaboration with IT.
Supporting key users and helping resolve issues efficiently.
Taking ownership of the XPLM interface between EPLAN and Teamcenter.
Leading projects related to the further development and rollout of the integration.
Planning user testing and introducing new solutions to the relevant users.

Your profile
You have worked in electrical design and have practical experience with EPLAN. Your background may include roles such as electrical designer, EPLAN administrator, application specialist, CAD/ECAD coordinator or application manager. What matters most is that you understand users’ day-to-day work and can take clear ownership of tool-related matters.
You should be comfortable gathering requirements, coordinating activities and driving initiatives forward with multiple stakeholders. The role suits someone who is structured, communicative and solution-oriented, with the ability to move between technical details and a broader application management perspective.
Mandatory requirements
Experience in electrical design.
Practical experience with EPLAN.
Ability to gather requirements and plan and drive activities.
Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written.

Desirable qualifications
Experience in EPLAN administration or application management.
Experience with Teamcenter.
Experience with XPLM or similar integrations between ECAD and PLM systems.
Experience with system upgrades, user testing or rollouts to multiple user groups.
Experience leading key user networks or working in an international organisation.

Assignment details
Assignment type: Consultancy assignment
Workload: Full-time, 100%
Location: Linköping, on-site
Start date: As soon as possible
Assignment duration: Six-month periods
Extension: Good prospects for extension
Language: Spoken and written English required
Why this assignment is interesting
This role offers significant practical influence over a core engineering design tool within a global technology organisation. You will work closely with electrical design teams, users and IT while driving an important integration between ECAD and PLM. The combination of technical depth, international collaboration and clear ownership makes this assignment particularly relevant for a consultant looking to move from a dedicated design role into tool ownership and technical application management.

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis: Methane removal from ventilation air at Henriksdal
jobs.description:
Methane is a strong greenhouse gas which is 28 times more potent than carbon dioxide. Methane is formed by microorganisms as a result of anaerobic transformation of organic matter. In wastewater handling, anaerobic conditions prevail in wastewater network, during the first wastewater treatment steps and in sludge handling processes at wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs). In order to limit methane emissions, an intensive work is being done to find biogas leaks and to destruct the methane in ventilation air. However, some ventilation streams have methane content significantly lower than 2 000 ppm, which is the lower limit for destruction using existing matured technologies. Direct methane emissions at Henriksdal WWTP stand for around 40% of all the climate impact of wastewater treatment and can be lowered if a suitable method for methane destruction be found and implemented.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
In the proposed project several alternatives of methane destruction will be tested experimentally. Biological trickling filters can be used for aerobic degradation of methane and it was demonstrated that the conversion rate can be significantly increased by applying a mixture of water and silicon oil as the liquid medium compared with using only water (Lebrero et al. 2015). It is planned to operate two trickling filters within the project, one with water and one with two-liquid medium, and treat real ventilation air from methane at Henriksdal WWTP. Methane and hydrogen sulphide reduction will be monitored. Moreover, chemical analysis of the liquid medium for nitrogen and phosphorus species will be performed regularly.

Another opportunity which will be explored is using the polluted air for aeration in the biological treatment step of the wastewater treatment process. This possibility will be explored in lab or pilot scale.

Two other possibilities, which will most probably be investigated only theoretically, is concentration by gas membranes and destruction in a membrane aerated biological reactor.

This Thesis project is experimentally oriented and big part of the work will include running experiments and performing chemical analyses. The Master Thesis project is to be performed during the spring term 2027 (30 hp).

KVALIFIKATIONER
To be eligible for this thesis project, you should be enrolled in a program within chemistry, environmental engineering, water engineering, or another relevant field of study.

Most of the work will be performed at Henriksdals reningsverk (Värmdövägen 23, Stockholm). Daily attendance is required.

Industrial supervisor: Andriy Malovanyy, andriy.malovanyy@svoa.se (SVOA).

Practical help: Gabriel Persson (SVOA).

This specific project is intended solely for students planning to conduct their thesis during the spring term 2027.  However, if you are interested in doing a thesis project with us during the autumn semester of 2027, there may be opportunities closer to that time.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.

The applicants are invited to send a short motivation letter (do not use AI !), a CV, and a transcript of records from education on university level with name of the courses and grades for those. The application can be done in English or Swedish. The Thesis can be written in either English or Swedish. The last day to apply is 15th of Dec 2025. Candidate selection is done continuously and will most probably be finalized in November. In line with SVOA policy, a successfully completed Master's project is rewarded with a compensation of 1 000 SEK (pre-tax) for every hp of the project (30 000 kr for a 30 hp project).

jobs.occupation: Business Specialist – Sales Channels – Nordic HQ at BSH

While the role covers all Nordic and Baltic markets, Sweden will be the primary market focus, reflecting its size, commercial potential and importance to our Customer Service business. 
 
 Based at our Nordic HQ in Stockholm, you will collaborate with stakeholders across Customer Service and other business functions to identify commercial opportunities, drive initiatives and contribute to sustainable business growth. 
 
        KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
Drive sales and commercial growth across Customer Service channels in the Nordic and Baltic markets, with primary focus on Sweden. 
Develop existing and new sales channels, including D2C, service technicians, Contact Center, service partners, retailers and other relevant commercial touchpoints. 
Identify market and channel opportunities to increase sales, conversion and customer value, and translate sales and performance insights into concrete commercial actions. 
Develop and implement commercial activities and new service offerings, including business cases to evaluate commercial potential and support decision-making. 
Coordinate launches and commercial rollouts across markets, ensure consistent execution and build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and relevant external partners. 
Follow up sales activities and commercial initiatives against targets and expected business impact and share best practices across markets while adapting activities to local needs.
 
  
 YOUR PROFILE: 
2–5 years of relevant experience in sales, commercial development, channel management, business development or a similar commercial role. 
Relevant education within business, sales, marketing or equivalent professional experience, and fluency in English. 
Commercial mindset with a strong interest in developing sales, channels and new business opportunities. 
Comfortable working with sales data and performance analysis and turning insights into clear commercial actions. 
Self-driven, proactive and structured, with the ability to take ownership from ideas through implementation and follow-up. 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence working across markets, functions and external partners. 
Nordic market knowledge and/or Nordic language skills are a plus. Knowledge of the Swedish market and/or Swedish language skills is a strong advantage. 

WHAT WE OFFER: 
A key commercial role with regional responsibility across seven Nordic and Baltic markets, with Sweden as the primary market focus. 
Close collaborate with stakeholders across Customer Service and other business functions to identify commercial opportunities, drive initiatives and contribute to sustainable business growth. 
Location: Nordic HQ, Stockholm 
Occasional travel within the Nordic and Baltic region may be required. 
Ideal starting date: As soon as possible 
Position type: Permanent 
Hybrid work model: Regular office presence in line with the company hybrid working model (currently approximately 60%). 

 
 INTERESTED? 
We offer an exciting opportunity to take a central role in the commercial development of Customer Service across Northern Europe. You will work with strong brands, a broad regional scope and close collaboration with key stakeholders at Nordic HQ and across our markets. 
While experience is a plus, we prioritize drive, commercial thinking, collaboration and integrity. If you believe you embody these qualities, we encourage you to apply even if you don't perfectly match all the requirements. 
Interested applicants are encouraged to submit their CV and cover letter in English. The selection process is ongoing throughout the recruitment period. We recommend submitting your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Tendering Engineer to a global company in Ludvika!
jobs.description:
About our client
Our client, who is a global and world leading company within their domain, strongly believes in the long-term sustainability of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology. This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.
About the role
We are looking for an experienced and driven Tender Engineer to join our client's HVDC organization in Ludvika. In this role, you will play an important part in developing competitive technical proposals for complex HVDC and power transmission projects, contributing to the development and modernization of power grids worldwide.
As a Tender Engineer, you will be part of a dedicated tendering team of approximately ten colleagues, working closely with engineering, project management, supply chain and commercial functions. Your main focus will be to analyze customer requirements, evaluate technical solutions and prepare accurate and competitive tenders that meet both technical and commercial expectations.
The role combines technical expertise with coordination, problem-solving and communication. You will work in an international environment where English is the primary working language, while being based on-site in Ludvika alongside your team.
Key responsibilities
Review customer specifications and technical requirements to prepare accurate and competitive tenders

Develop technical proposals and quotations for HVDC and power transmission projects

Evaluate technical solutions and identify potential risks and opportunities

Collaborate with engineering, project management and commercial teams throughout the tendering process

Provide technical input for cost estimates, project planning and proposals

Prepare and review technical documentation for tenders

Participate in technical discussions with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

Who are you?
We are looking for a technically skilled and self-driven engineer who enjoys combining analytical work with collaboration and communication. You have a solid background in electrical engineering, power systems or a related technical field, and feel confident interpreting technical specifications and translating complex requirements into practical solutions.
To succeed in this role, you are structured, analytical and comfortable taking ownership of your work. You have a proactive mindset, strong communication skills and enjoy working closely with colleagues across different disciplines in an international environment.
We are looking for someone who has:
At least 5 years of experience working as a Tender Engineer or in a similar role, with proven hands-on experience in technical tendering and proposal development

A technical educational background, preferably in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience

Good understanding of electrical power systems, power transmission or energy infrastructure

Experience reviewing and understanding technical specifications, engineering documents and customer requirements

Excellent communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience with HVDC, FACTS, STATCOM or similar power systems

Experience in technical project execution or customer-facing engineering roles

Experience working in international engineering projects

Swedish language skills

Practical information
Location: Ludvika, Sweden
Scope: Full-time
Start date: As agreed

jobs.description:
What do UEFA's Euro championship, Red Bull's marketing operations and Coca-Cola's production planning have in common?
They are all powered by Bryntum's JavaScript components.
Our components (Gantt, Scheduler, Calendar, Grid) live embedded in business-critical systems at 5,000 companies across 80 countries. That puts extreme demands on every release, every API decision, and every trade-off.
Bryntum is now looking for a Frontend Product Engineer who understands exactly what that means and wants to own those decisions.
About the role This role covers product strategy, prioritization and backlog ownership as well as hands-on frontend development. You are a developer who is driven by product questions and strategy. You keep track of incoming requests and bugs, hold the big picture together without losing sight of the details. You turn real feedback from our active developer community into improvements that balance long-term direction with short-term delivery.
Our customers are developers, not end users. You'll read bug reports, screenshots and code snippets and translate them into improvements that actually matter. We also want you to build a tighter feedback loop directly with customers, to learn how people actually use and experience our product.
 What we're looking for

8+ years of experience as a frontend developer, with strong skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks (React, Angular or Vue)

Experience taking product ownership for what you build, shaping requirements, prioritizing work and driving technical decisions

Experience with API design and backwards compatibility

Experience leading technical customer conversations and product discussions in English

Strong written communication: specs, product documentation and clear requirements

 Meritorious Experience from an SDK or component library company is a plus. A big bonus is comfort and ambition around modern AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex, it's something we genuinely care about.
Fluent English is a requirement, Swedish is a plus. 
 Who you are To thrive in this role, you're genuinely tech-curious, someone who loves having many touchpoints and brings real ambition to everything you take on. You will make decisions that affect thousands of production systems. You listen, read the room and know how to handle demanding customers in a way that builds relationships. You're comfortable with high ownership and like keeping things organized. You enjoy working independently and act proactively even in uncertain situations. 
What we offer

6 weeks of vacation

ITP pension and insurance

Wellness allowance

Freedom with responsibility. You own your day as long as the work gets done

Hybrid model with a Stockholm hub at Epicenter

One joint team trip per year where the whole organization comes together

 Apply Does this sound like a role for you? We review applications on a rolling basis, so don't hesitate to reach out today. For questions, contact Johanna Ottosson at johanna.ottosson@ants.se.
About Bryntum Bryntum was founded in 2009 by Mats, who remains CEO and active in the company today. In 2025 we were acquired by Adelis Equity Partners and are now establishing a Stockholm hub at Epicenter.
For over 15 years we've delivered world-class JavaScript components for scheduling, project management and data visualization. We're a team of developers driven by quality and genuine passion for what we build. The culture is unpretentious and open. We believe in freedom with responsibility and a low meeting culture, so you can focus on what actually matters and what you enjoy. Read more about us here: Bryntum

Lärare i matematik 7-9 IES Österåker öppnade i augusti 2024 och är en modern F–9-skola med höga ambitioner.När skolan är fullt utbyggd kommer den att ha cirka 600 elever, fördelade på två klasser per årskurs.

Vi följer den svenska läroplanen och har möjlighet att bedriva upp till 50 procent av undervisningen på engelska. Vår verksamhet bygger på tydliga rutiner, höga förväntningar och en trygg lärmiljö där både elever och medarbetare ges möjlighet att utvecklas och lyckas.

Skolan ligger centralt i Åkersberga, cirka 30 minuter från Stockholm. Vårt campus består av både nybyggda och renoverade lokaler och har nära tillgång till idrottsanläggningar, natur och Stockholms skärgård.

Vi söker nu en erfaren och behörig matematiklärare för årskurs 7–9 som vill bli en del av vårt team.

Om tjänsten

Som lärare ansvarar du för att planera, genomföra, bedöma och följa upp elevernas lärande i matematik. Du hjälper eleverna att utveckla tilltro till sin egen förmåga, stärka sina problemlösningsstrategier och nå goda kunskapsresultat.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att möta elever med olika behov och förutsättningar. Du behöver kunna ge stöd till elever som har utmaningar i matematik, samtidigt som du erbjuder fördjupning och ytterligare utmaningar till elever som behöver utvecklas vidare.

Det finns även möjlighet att undervisa i IGCSE Mathematics i årskurs 9 för den som är intresserad och har relevant erfarenhet eller kompetens.

I tjänsten ingår mentorskap för en grupp elever samt ett nära samarbete med vårdnadshavare, kollegor, elevhälsoteamet och skolledningen för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för elevernas utveckling och lärande.

Vi söker dig som:

- Har en giltig lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i matematik för årskurs 7–9.
- Behärskar både svenska och engelska obehindrat.
- Kan undervisa i matematik på både svenska och engelska med god säkerhet.
- Har flera års dokumenterad erfarenhet av framgångsrik undervisning.
- Har god förmåga att hjälpa elever som har svårt med matematik att utvecklas och nå sina mål.
- Har erfarenhet av att stödja och utmana elever med hög måluppfyllelse och goda ämneskunskaper.
- Har erfarenhet av eller kunskap om IGCSE Mathematics. Detta är meriterande men inget krav.
- Skapar en lugn, strukturerad och positiv lärmiljö.
- Har höga förväntningar på alla elever och tror på varje elevs förmåga att utvecklas.
- Samarbetar väl med kollegor och trivs med att arbeta i team.
- Ger tydlig och utvecklande återkoppling som hjälper eleverna att komma vidare i sitt lärande.

Vi erbjuder:

- En skola med tydliga rutiner och ett närvarande och engagerat ledarskap.
- Stöttande och engagerade kollegor.
- En internationell arbetsmiljö.
- Möjlighet att vara med och bygga upp och utveckla en växande skola.
- En verksamhetskultur med fokus på lärande, respekt och goda kunskapsresultat.

Anställningsvillkor

Tjänsten är på 100 procent. Sex månaders provanställning tillämpas.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag.

Utdrag ur belastningsregistret ska uppvisas före anställning.

Vill du vara med och forma framtidens första steg i lärandet?

Vi söker en legitimerad lärare F–3 med behörighet att undervisa i förskoleklass – en nyckelroll i elevernas livslånga läranderesa. I ljuset av den kommande läroplanen 2028 utvecklar vi undervisning som sätter elevens nyfikenhet, språk- och matematikutveckling samt utforskande arbetssätt i centrum.

Internationella Engelska Skolan har i över 30 år haft en positiv inverkan på sina elevers utveckling. Vi är övertygade om att detta framgångsrika resultat kommer från vårt starka etos, där engagerade och närvarande ledare skapar en miljö där alla strävar mot gemensamma mål. Hos oss får lärarna fokus på det viktigaste – undervisning och lärande. Eleverna är alltid i centrum, och alla elever är dina elever. Vi tror på värderingar som grund för framgång, och samarbete är en självklar del av vårt sätt att arbeta.

Hos oss skapar du inspirerande lärmiljöer där lek, kreativitet och praktiskt lärande är centrala verktyg – i linje med läroplanens ökade fokus på elevaktivt lärande och helhetsförståelse. Du följer elevernas utveckling genom att dokumentera, analysera och anpassa undervisningen för att ge varje elev bästa möjliga förutsättningar att lyckas.

På IES Kungsbacka bygger vi en skola där varje elev ges möjlighet att nå sin fulla potential – kunskapsmässigt, socialt och personligt. Vi värdesätter mångfald och ser elevernas olika erfarenheter, språk och perspektiv som en tillgång i undervisningen.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat lärarlag där det finns avsatt tid för kollegialt lärande, pedagogisk utveckling och att tillsammans utforska framtidens undervisning. I förskoleklassen samarbetar svensk- och engelsktalande lärare, vilket skapar en dynamisk och internationell lärmiljö.

 Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad grundlärare med behörighet för förskoleklass och som vill vara med och utveckla undervisning i takt med framtidens krav och möjligheter.

Du har en positiv människosyn och bygger förtroendefulla relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Du motiverar och engagerar elever genom tydlig kommunikation och ett inkluderande arbetssätt, och du ser styrkan i att undervisa i en flerspråkig och mångkulturell miljö.

Du uttrycker dig väl i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska och använder digitala verktyg som en naturlig del av undervisningen – i linje med läroplanens fokus på digital kompetens och framtidsfärdigheter.

Vi söker en lagspelare som drivs av skolutveckling och som vill bidra till en undervisning där elever inte bara lär – utan växer, utforskar och utvecklar förmågor de bär med sig in i framtiden.

 Vill du arbeta i en skola där studiero, tydligt ledarskap och höga förväntningar gör verklig skillnad - varje dag?  

Internationella Engelska Skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vår tydliga etos med engagerad personal som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum för allt vi gör, alla elever är dina elever. 

På Internationella Engelska Skolan är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att tycka om att jobba hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.    

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vi söker nu en engagerad lärare i fritidshem som vill vara med och vidareutveckla vår verksamhet i en internationell och tvåspråkig miljö. I ditt uppdrag arbetar du aktivt för att stimulera elevernas lärande och utveckling, med utgångspunkt i deras behov, intressen och erfarenheter. Samtidigt utmanar du dem att nå nya höjder genom att inspirera till ny kunskap och nya perspektiv.

Du planerar, genomför och utvärderar fritidsverksamheten tillsammans med dina kollegor, med fokus på kvalitet, tydlighet och kontinuerlig utveckling. Genom varierade arbetssätt, kreativa lärmiljöer och en tydlig struktur skapar du en meningsfull fritid där eleverna utvecklas både socialt och kunskapsmässigt.

Du har en viktig roll i att bygga en stark gemenskap där elever känner sig trygga, sedda och motiverade att lyckas. Möjlighet till en förstelärartjänst inom fritidshem finns.Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad grundlärare med inriktning mot fritidshem och som drivs av att skapa en trygg, strukturerad och inspirerande lärmiljö.

Du är väl insatt i läroplanen och arbetar målmedvetet för att utveckla kvaliteten i verksamheten. Med din energi och kreativitet inspirerar du både elever och kollegor, och du trivs i en kultur där samarbete och professionalism är centralt.

Du använder digitala verktyg som en naturlig del av din undervisning och dokumentation. Eftersom vi är en internationell skola är det viktigt att du behärskar både svenska och engelska väl, i tal och skrift.

Som person är du en tydlig ledare som skapar struktur och arbetsro. Du bygger starka relationer och har förmågan att motivera elever att utvecklas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar -  alltid med höga förväntningar och ett positivt förhållningssätt.Varför välja oss?

Hos oss blir du en del av en professionell och internationell arbetsmiljö där:

- Tydliga strukturer skapar studiero
- Engagerade kollegor samarbetar och stöttar varandra
- Höga förväntningar leder till goda resultat
- Du får möjlighet att påverka och utveckla verksamheten

Vill du vara med och göra skillnad i en skola där ambition, trygghet och kvalitet går hand i hand?

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100% med 6 månaders provanställning.

Startdatum: Januari

 Välkommen med din ansökan!

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

Position at LeoVegas Group
ABOUT THE ROLE
Join our team as a Senior Software Engineer and play a crucial role in driving our organisation's growth through the development of outstanding products.
LeoVegas Group is building something special – a world-class team dedicated to creating the best Sportsbook platform in the market through cutting-edge technology and innovative gaming experiences.
This is a dynamic team that will be working on creating new cool features and integrating them into LeoVegas platforms.
We’re seeking a dynamic individual who can deliver state-of-the-art code while prioritising performance and scalability.
We are recruiting for our Tiger Sportsbook Team!
In Sportsbook we work in a high-volume, real-time environment, integrating data feeds with our modern trading system and transactional betting platform (UI/Backend). Your contributions will cover maintaining/expanding our current Betting/Trading services as well as building new services and capabilities for our users.
As a key member of our team, you’ll collaborate effectively while also demonstrating initiative and a passion for sharing innovative ideas.
YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:
● Taking ownership, problem-solving and collaborating with other teams.
● Designing and implementing from idea to production.
● Building for scale, availability, performance and security across the stack.
● Working with product managers, architects, QA engineers and other developers in a highly collaborative agile environment.
● Integrating new products and building internal services to support our ecosystem.
● Conducting code reviews and mentoring team members.
● Ensuring services are production-ready, observable, and maintainable through monitoring, alerting, and on-call participation.
OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:
ESSENTIAL SKILLS:
● 6+ Years of software development experience with Java, Spring Boot and Event-Driven Architectures.
● Experience designing microservices, K8s, containerization (Docker) and Kafka messaging systems.
● Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases and caching.
● Implementing resilience patterns (e.g., retries, circuit breakers, graceful degradation).
● Designing and maintaining monitoring dashboards (e.g., metrics, logs, traces) and alerts to proactively detect issues.
● Hands-on experience developing highly scalable RESTful end-to-end microservices.
NICE TO HAVES:
● Familiarity with Reactive Programming (e.g. RxJava) and Vert.x would be a big plus.
● Experience in platforms like AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
● Online gaming and gambling experience

WHO WE ARE
 At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
30 annual vacation days
Occupational Pension
5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
Parental Leave Top-Up
Possibility to enroll in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner
1,500 SEK equipment allowance

💡 What We Do
Swiftly gaining ground as Sweden’s industry leader in battery storage and expanding rapidly in selected European markets, Flower is on a mission to enable the energy system of tomorrow. With an industry-leading AI-powered platform at its core, our service includes stabilizing the energy system by enhancing predictability and flexibility for both energy producers and consumers. By combining pioneering technology with a portfolio of flexible energy assets, we break new ground towards a fossil-free energy system, allowing clean energy to power society.
🌟 Who We Are
Tech company at heart – purpose in our DNA. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world. At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.
To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled Senior Software Engineer.
👩‍💻 About The Role:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Flower, you will be at the forefront of the energy transformation. You will work on systems that manage energy flexibility, integrating cutting-edge software solutions to enhance efficiency and reliability. You will collaborate with a high-performing, cross-functional team and guide them on their path towards finding a solution. You will help ensure system reliability, security, and performance through best coding practices and architecture decisions.
What You’ll Do:

Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable software solutions for our energy platform.

Work with technologies such as Go, AWS, IoT Core and Databricks.

Build and optimize high-performance backend services and data processing pipelines as well as a fleet of IoT devices.

Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and other engineers from across the organisation.

Lead code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and mentoring other engineers.

Be an active part of the culture, with focus on continuous improvement and technical and operational excellence.

Who You Are:

You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, working with backend development and distributed systems.

Proficient in Go, with experience in designing scalable services and APIs.

Hands-on experience with communication protocols such as MQTT, Modbus, and IEC104.

Familiarity with AI development tools and practices as they evolve.

Experience with modern DevOps principles such as CI/CD, IaC, and observability tooling like OpenTelemetry.

Passionate about working on impactful projects that contribute to a sustainable future.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with an ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

📍 Location
Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.
✉️ Apply
Our corporate language is English, as we have about 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will meet with the Talent Partner, the Head of Asset Integration, the Team, and the VP of Engineering. We look forward to hearing from you!

We kindly but firmly decline any engagement in recruitment assistance for our hiring processes. This includes partnership offers or the sale of recruitment tools.
